title: Evidence may be given only of facts in issue and of facts declared relevant

content.overview: Evidence may be given only of facts in issue and of facts declared relevant. BSA Chapter II (ss. 3–50). The gateway is s. 3. Same-transaction facts are s. 4 ([[REF:DOCTRINE:EVIDENCE-LAW:RES-GESTAE|res gestae]]). Current law from 1 July 2024; IEA numbers are historical concordance only.
